title: G650
summary: Case study of a private-jet acquisition loan arranged by Silver Oak Capital. Amount: $40 million. Asset: Gulfstream G650 private jet. Borrower: a wealthy Emirati (UAE) individual described as having 'a penchant for luxury and business travel', who wanted long-term funding to buy the jet and needed access to financing soon after purchase ('fast post-purchase financing'). Lender type: a European private bank ('tailored European private bank lending'). Structure per search summaries: 80% loan-to-value, 10-year term, rate 3.5% plus Euribor, 1.5% lender fee, repayment amortised over 10 years with a 30% balloon, and $5 million in assets under management (listed among the key terms; appears to be a private-bank AUM condition, but the page wording was not seen). Timing: no completion timescale stated beyond the client's need for financing soon after purchase. Challenges flagged by the page: aircraft valuation, maintenance costs, regulatory compliance, and whether the jet suited the client's travel needs. Outcome: the $40m facility was arranged. One search summary noted the terms 'are presented as a sample deal'. No H1, meta description, FAQ, process steps or calls to action were revealed in the snippets.
